description: A client-side Fabric mod that breaks bedrock in survival with the vanilla headless-piston trick (MC-27056) — any mining speed, with auto mode.

mods.name: Bedrock Miner Extra
mods.description: Pure-client mod: automates the headless-piston trick (MC-27056) so bedrock can be broken in survival without instant mining. Place a piston against bedrock, power it with a lever or redstone torch, then mine the piston at any speed - the mod instantly sends the packets to replace it with a fresh piston facing the bedrock and cut the power.

releases.notes:
# Bedrock Miner Extra 2.5.3

## 更新内容

- 适配 Minecraft 26.3，并保留 1.19.4、1.20.x、1.21.x、26.1、26.1.2、26.2 等版本构建。
- 修复白名单命令的完整方块 ID 解析：简写和带 `minecraft:` 前缀的 ID 都可以添加、删除，Tab 补全结果也能正常使用。
- 自动模式新增快捷键，可在 malilib 配置界面中设置；快捷键切换时显示物品栏上方提示，设置会保存并在重启后保留。`/bedrockMinerExtra auto` 仍可直接切换自动模式。
- 修复立式告示牌与墙面告示牌的白名单识别，支持手动破坏。自动模式在空间受限的布局中仍可能提示空间不足，此时可以使用手动模式。
- 新增粘性活塞支持开关，默认关闭；开启后优先使用普通活塞，只有没有普通活塞时才使用粘性活塞。
- 自动挖掘预热时间调整为约 0.2 秒，之后保持使用最快的可用工具；只有达到瞬间破坏速度时才走瞬挖收尾。

## 构建产物

本目录包含 11 个支持版本的客户端 JAR：1.19.4、1.20.1、1.20.5、1.20.6、1.21、1.21.1、1.21.11、26.1、26.1.2、26.2、26.3。

releases.notes:
2.2.1 — multi-version & cleanup fixes

Supported versions (10): 26.2 / 26.1 / 26.1.2, 1.21.11 / 1.21.1 / 1.21, 1.20.6 / 1.20.5 / 1.20.1, 1.19.4

New in 2.2.x

1.19.4 added to the supported versions (any mining speed works, like 1.20+)
1.18.2 removed: before 1.19.3 there is no block-break prediction system, so the headless-piston trick only works with instant mining inside the piston's 2-tick retraction window — that conflicts with this mod's any-speed design
Fixes

Cleanup (after a failure or a successful break) could get stuck mining a piston at the last bit of progress — leftover mining state is now cleared before re-mining, and cleanup slow-mines first for reliable client/server progress sync
Generic failure message no longer claims "may be powered by redstone"
Also in this release line (2.1.2 → 2.1.3)

Nether-roof flat bedrock (breaking the y128 roof from above): the piston is placed on top of the target with its head up, and the lever goes on top of an adjacent bedrock block — power: lever → bedrock → target → piston
Tab completion for the whitelist commands: blockWhitelist add completes every block id (with or without the minecraft: prefix), remove completes your current whitelist
Lever reuse: an existing lever that already powers the lever's attach block (even off-axis) is reused instead of placing a second one
Non-lever power sources detected: if the spot is powered by redstone dust/repeater/button/..., it is skipped with a "position powered by redstone" message instead of wasting blocks
Since 2.0.0 (recap): auto mode (left-click bedrock to break it, 5-slot queue), blocked-slot fallback, exact lever placement, auto-cleanup, action-bar messages, linked on/off switches.

releases.notes:
2.1.1 — Bug fix

The two switches are now linked: /bedrockMinerExtra off also turns auto mode off, and /bedrockMinerExtra auto on keeps the manual flow on (auto mode depends on it).
Highlights since 2.0.0 (auto mode matured a lot):

Blocked-slot fallback: if the piston spot is blocked (e.g. you're standing there), auto mode tries the other faces instead of failing.
Exact lever placement: the lever attaches exactly where intended — prefers the target bedrock (100% reliable piston activation), then the piston's side; no longer affected by server view lag.
Auto-cleanup: after a successful break, leftover pistons and levers are mined away automatically.
Faster finish: switches to an instant pickaxe once progress ≥ 0.7 (or after 0.2 s).
All status messages now show in the action bar instead of the chat; debug logs are commented out (kept in code).
